settings.text: We want you to love your Anima Jewels pieces. If you are not completely satisfied, returns are free within 30 days. Here is how it works.

settings.title: Free 30-day returns
settings.text: You have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return or exchange, and we cover the return shipping.

settings.title: Item condition
settings.text: To be eligible, your jewelry must be unworn, free of scratches, and returned in its original packaging (including the anti-tarnish pouch).

settings.title: How to start a return
settings.text: Contact us with your order number within 30 days of delivery. We will send return instructions and a free return label.

settings.title: Refund processing
settings.text: Approved refunds are credited back to your original payment method within 5–7 business days.

Items must be unworn and in their original packaging. Some items are final sale and cannot be returned. Items sent back without first requesting a return can’t be accepted. You can cancel an order within 24 hours of placing it. These terms do not limit your rights under applicable law; see our full refund policy.
